title: e1: Learning Adaptive Control of Reasoning Effort
abstract: arXiv:2510.27042v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Increasing the thinking budget of AI models can significantly improve accuracy, but not all questions warrant the same amount of reasoning. Users may prefer to allocate different amounts of reasoning effort depending on how they value output quality versus latency and cost. To leverage this tradeoff effectively, users need fine-grained control over the amount of thinking used for a particular query, but few approaches enable such control. Existing methods require users to specify the absolute number of desired tokens, but this requires knowing the difficulty of the problem beforehand to appropriately set the token budget for a query. To address these issues, we propose \textit{Adaptive Effort Control}, a self-adaptive reinforcement learning method that trains models to use a user-specified fraction of tokens relative to the current average chain-of-thought length for each query. translated_title: e1：学习推理努力程度的自适应控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.27042v3 公告类型：替换。摘要：增加AI模型的思考预算可以显著提高准确性，但并非所有问题都需要同等程度的推理。用户可能希望根据自己对输出质量与延迟和成本之间权衡的偏好，分配不同数量的推理努力。为了有效利用这种权衡，用户需要对特定查询所使用的思考量进行细粒度控制，但很少有方法能够实现这种控制。现有方法要求用户指定所需的绝对token数量，但这需要预先了解问题的难度才能为查询适当地设置token预算。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了自适应努力控制，这是一种自自适应强化学习方法，训练模型使用相对于每个查询当前平均思维链长度的、用户指定比例的token数量。这种方法消除了针对特定数据集和训练阶段而设置的超参数。
tldr: 提出“自适应努力控制”强化学习方法，让模型能够按照用户指定的相对比例（相对于当前问题的平均思维链长度）自动调节推理token用量，从而在无需预知问题难度的情况下实现对推理努力程度的细粒度控制。
en_tdlr: Proposes Adaptive Effort Control, a self-adaptive reinforcement learning method that trains models to use a user-specified fraction of tokens relative to each query's average chain-of-thought length, enabling fine-grained control over reasoning effort without requiring prior knowledge of problem difficulty.
